careerOutcomes.title: Career outcomes
careerOutcomes.subtitle: Aggregate student career outcomes across employers. No student personal data or salary is shown.
careerOutcomes.permissionBody: You do not have permission to view career outcomes.
careerOutcomes.privacyNote: This surface shows aggregate, privacy-safe outcomes only — no student identity and no salary. System-estimated outcomes are derived from accepted offers and may be refined by higher-trust sources later.
careerOutcomes.lowSignalBody: Only {count} outcomes recorded — treat the aggregates below as indicative, not conclusive.
careerOutcomes.aiInsightsDisclaimer: Advisory reading of the aggregates above. Not a prediction; verify before publishing.
careerOutcomes.emptyBody: Outcomes appear here once candidates accept offers. They are estimated until confirmed by higher-trust sources.
careerOutcomes.insightManyOutcomes: Strong placement record — share outcomes publicly to attract more partners
careerOutcomes.insightDiverseEmployers: Students placed across many employers — strong network diversity
careerOutcomes.insightHighTrust: High-confidence placements recorded — data quality supports outcome reporting
careerOutcomes.insightNoOutcomes: No outcomes recorded yet — invite alumni to confirm career updates
